Masterwork elves are very similar to vanilla. They are still very snobbish treehuggers that feel offended whenever you try to trade anything made out of wood with them.
However, staying on good terms with the elves is a good thing, since you can ask their diplomats to bring fun creatures to sell your dwarves, such as Forest Spiders (sometimes giant ones), Giant Tigers, Forest Gryphons and Grizzly Bears. They also bring many instruments, tools and weapons made out of [[mithril]], this being the only metal they work with.

Elven caravans now arrive with guards to protect the merchants, frequently with at least 2 forest spiders.
